question: In which facial location should the kalā Śānti be placed with the Tatpuruṣa mantra?
premises: The kalā to be placed is Śānti.
The specified location is the eastern face.
inference: One should place the kalā Śānti in the eastern face with the Tatpuruṣa mantra.
plain_english: With ‘tatpuruṣāya vidmahe’, one should place the kalā Śānti in the eastern face.
